title.narrative: Implementing Caritas Lebanon Safeguarding Action Plan

description.narrative: Caritas Lebanon (CL) abides by international standards on protection and safeguarding, and has therefore established a safeguarding unit in 2020, whose tasks include the creation of safeguarding, feedback and complaint mechanism policies. The overall objective for CL is the safeguarding of its beneficiaries, holding itself accountable, as well as promoting a culture of zero tolerance to sexual exploitation and abuse. As Lebanon is facing a severe multi-layered crisis, the number of beneficiaries visiting CL’s centres is constantly increasing, and the further vulnerability increases, the more beneficiaries are at risk of SEA. Hence, in order to prevent/mitigate any SEA incident, there is an important need to enhance Caritas Lebanon's organizational safeguarding mechanisms and policies. Caritas Lebanon's safeguarding Unit has elaborate a safeguarding action plan for 2023 to meet organizational safeguarding priorities agreed by CL's senior management and CIMOs. The present capacity building grant will contribute to the implementation of Caritas Lebanon Safeguarding action plan.
